mapper.insert: insert into diary (user_id, title, content, mood_type, sentiment_emotion, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, diary_date) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{moodType}, #{sentimentEmotion}, #{sentimentScore}, #{sentimentLabel}, #{diaryDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, mood_type, sentiment_emotion, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, confidence, keywords, created_at, updated_at FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM diary WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT mood_type AS moodType, count(*) AS value FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY mood_type

SELECT diary_date, COUNT(*) AS diary_count, ROUND(AVG(sentiment_score), 2) AS avg_score, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(mood_type ORDER BY created_at DESC), ',', 1 ) AS main_mood FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND diary_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY diary_date ORDER BY diary_date ASC
select * from diary where diary_date = #{diaryDate} and user_id = #{userId}
